_comment: 19 HAND-RULED proposal/memory pairs, every one ruled `reject` on 2026-10-05 after
reading the cited memory. This is a ground-truth set for the corpus-coverage pre-check
in cmd_propose: for each pair the check SHOULD have said 'the corpus already has this'
and did not, so the proposal sat in the queue for weeks.
Why it exists as a file: the check has been calibrated by anecdote twice (COVER_J went
0.55 -> 0.45 on a single measured true positive). A threshold tuned on one example is
a threshold nobody can re-measure after the corpus moves. Run measure-coverage-check.py
against this before changing COVER_J or the candidate query.
`cited` is the memory that made the ruling. Several proposals were not merely duplicates
but REFUTED by their cited memory, which is noted in `verdict`.

cases.name: droidguard-header-empty-bypass-strategy
cases.description: The Droid-Guard HTTP header can be bypassed by returning an empty byte array instead of a malformed attestation.

cases.name: rcs-provisioning-acs-header-empty-vs-absent
cases.description: RCS provisioning ACS endpoints distinguish between empty and absent Droid-Guard headers.

cases.name: rcs-provisioning-throttling-cooldown-strategy
cases.description: Respect server-side Retry-After headers during RCS provisioning to avoid extended lockout periods.

cases.name: rcs-provisioning-runbook-constraint
cases.description: Limit RCS provisioning attempts to a strict budget of two requests per window to avoid server-side throttling.

cases.name: gms-phenotype-droidguard-v2-bypass-verification
cases.description: DroidGuard v2 bypass in Bugle is achieved by forcing the omission of the Droid-Guard header via Phenotype flag configuration.

cases.name: gms-rpc-positive-control-strategy
cases.description: Use positive control replays to validate RPC request construction before bisecting individual parameters.

cases.name: instrument-discrimination-verification-strategy
cases.description: Verify that a diagnostic probe can produce distinct outcomes before relying on its results.

cases.name: log-filtering-denylist-strategy
cases.description: Use denylists for log filtering to ensure visibility of novel, high-signal events.

cases.name: calyx-signature-spoofing-cert-mismatch
cases.description: CalyxOS signature spoofing requires matching signing certificates between the spoofing provider and the target app.

cases.name: multi-sim-slot-priority-risk
cases.description: Multi-SIM devices may contain inactive or dead profiles in lower-indexed slots that report out-of-service status.

cases.name: rcs-provisioning-acs-throttle-wall
cases.description: RCS ACS provisioning throttling is enforced via a fixed daily wall-clock window rather than dynamic backoff.

cases.name: rcs-provisioning-deregistration-mechanism
cases.description: RCS deregistration is handled via the web form, not the client-side toggle.

cases.name: rcs-provisioning-server-side-reset-necessity
cases.description: RCS provisioning failures due to server-side state locking require manual user-initiated deactivation.

cases.name: rcs-provisioning-refresh-vs-initial-state
cases.description: RCS ACS provisioning returns empty version=0 configs for already-provisioned MSISDNs during refresh cycles.

cases.name: droidguard-payload-structural-divergence
cases.description: microG's DroidGuard VM payload diverges structurally from genuine GMS due to internal execution path differences.

cases.name: gms-verification-rpc-permission-denied
cases.description: GMS verification failures with PERMISSION_DENIED at the RPC level indicate server-side authorization refusal rather than local spoofing gaps.

cases.name: rcs-provisioning-runbook-strategy
cases.description: Prioritize static analysis and implementation of known-missing provisioning legs during hardware cooldowns.

cases.name: priv-app-allowlist-verification-strategy
cases.description: Verify privileged permission grants by mounting the final image and checking against the framework's boot-time requirements.

cases.name: gms-rpc-framing-bias-risk
cases.description: Avoid assuming that complex security mechanisms like DroidGuard attestation are mandatory for all GMS RPC endpoints.

controls._comment: Proposals ruled HOLD, NOT duplicates: the check must NOT fire on these, or it would downgrade genuinely new lessons.
controls.name: stremio-library-item-state-semantics
controls.description: The LibraryItemState.last_watched field is a composite timestamp, not a pure 'last human watch' event.

controls.name: tv-cache-write-coalescing-strategy
controls.description: Implement write coalescing for TV cache updates to balance performance and data integrity.

controls.name: verdict-finalization-crash-safety
controls.description: Finalization logic must explicitly validate completion and error state, not just check-pass booleans.
